import subprocess

# Check git log
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("=== Git log (base..HEAD) ===")
print(result.stdout)

# Count commits
lines = result.stdout.strip().split('\n')
print(f"Number of commits: {len(lines)}")

# Run all tests
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-x', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', 
     'tests/test_cacheutils.py', 'tests/test_debugutils_trace.py', 'tests/test_dictutils.py',
     'tests/test_ecoutils.py', 'tests/test_fileutils.py', 'tests/test_formatutils.py',
     'tests/test_funcutils.py', 'tests/test_funcutils_fb.py', 'tests/test_funcutils_fb_py3.py',
     'tests/test_gcutils.py', 'tests/test_ioutils.py', 'tests/test_iterutils.py',
     'tests/test_jsonutils.py', 'tests/test_listutils.py', 'tests/test_mathutils.py',
     'tests/test_namedutils.py', 'tests/test_queueutils.py', 'tests/test_setutils.py',
     'tests/test_socketutils.py', 'tests/test_statsutils.py', 'tests/test_statsutils_histogram.py',
     'tests/test_strutils.py', 'tests/test_tableutils.py', 'tests/test_tbutils.py',
     'tests/test_tbutils_parsed_exc.py', 'tests/test_timeutils.py', 'tests/test_typeutils.py',
     'tests/test_urlutils.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120
)
print("\n=== Test results ===")
print(result.stdout[-500:])
